ns2:course.label: Forensic Veterinary Medicine
ns2:course.description: This is a small group discussion and lecture-style course discussing different aspects of veterinary forensic medicine. Each session is devoted to a different aspect of veterinary forensic medicine. Classes are lecture style with periods of group discussion. Each session is 1 hour in length. No graduate credit. 1 professional hour. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM1 or VM2 standing.
